{{Top|leg}}
'''Bolt Leader''' was the callsign used by the commander of [[Bolt Squadron (Khuiumin Survivors)|Bolt]]. The position was held by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tyresi Gurtt]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], and she was succeeded by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] in that role.
